articles.title: This Stock Is Quietly Becoming an AI Powerhouse in 2026
articles.summary: Cisco just posted its fifth straight earnings beat and the stock has surged over 60% in a year, yet most investors still think of it as the old router company. The AI order numbers buried in its latest report tell a very different story.
